title: Car battery dies when parked for days
hook: Parking your car for a week? Do this first
youtube_title: Why does my car battery die when parked? How to prevent it

items: Ask someone to drive it weekly

slides.heading: Slow start is the first warning

voice_lines: Even when parked, your car's computers and alarm draw a little power, so a battery can go flat in a few weeks.
Drive it for twenty to thirty minutes once a week. Just idling for two minutes doesn't recharge it.
Away for longer? Ask someone to drive it, use a battery maintainer, or disconnect the negative terminal.
Warning signs: slow cranking, white crust on the terminals, and a battery over three or four years old. Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram.
caption:
Car parked for a week or more? Your battery is still working 🔋

The alarm and computers draw a little power all the time, so a battery can go flat in a few weeks.

✅ Drive 20-30 minutes once a week
❌ Idling for 2 minutes doesn't recharge it

Away longer: someone drives it weekly, a battery maintainer, or disconnect the negative terminal (some settings may reset).

Warning signs: slow cranking, white crust on terminals, battery older than 3-4 years in Indian heat.

Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram 👇
